function.name: coaching_method
function.description:
How to coach with these tools: the principles and step-by-step workflows (plan, review, check in,
change a workout, update the profile). Call this first, before planning, reviewing or changing workouts.

function.name: get_profile
function.description:
The user's coaching profile: preferences (what they like and don't), limitations (injuries, pain, what to
avoid), plan (their current split, schedule, goals) and coach notes. Read it before planning or reviewing.
It overrides the general method, except on safety. A new user has none yet (exists=false): ask them.

function.name: update_profile
function.description:
Edit the user's coaching profile. Each section is free text; pass the full new text of the sections you
change (read get_profile first and keep what's still true), '' to empty one; sections left out stay as they
are. Returns the changes. Dry run unless write=True: show the user the changes and save only once they
approve. Use it when they tell you a preference, an injury changes, or a review teaches you something.

function.name: workout_schema
function.description: The JSON Schema every workout must match (workout → exercises → sets). Read it before writing a workout.

function.name: recent_completed
function.description:
The user's most recent completed workouts, newest first, with every set (lbs, reps, done, custom).
inProgress: true = still going: the tracker saves as you go, so its done sets are what's
logged so far; Finish sets inProgress to false.

function.name: recent_assigned
function.description: Most recently assigned (planned) workouts, newest assignedFor first. The app loads the earliest one not yet completed.

function.name: get_workout
function.description: One workout by its doc ID. Edit the result and pass it to update_workout to change it.

function.name: exercise_history
function.description:
Past sets for an exercise, newest first. Loose match on the name (case, spacing, punctuation,
plurals, word order), so 'push up' finds 'Pushups'. For synonyms, check exercise_names first.

function.name: exercise_names
function.description:
Every distinct exercise name Thom has logged, with how often and when last done.
Names are free text: decide which ones mean the same exercise, and ask Thom when unsure.

function.name: assign_workout
function.description:
Post a new workout to Thom's assigned list. Fills id and assignedFor if missing (assignedFor = the date
it's for, e.g. '2026-10-08'). Validates against workout_schema. Dry run unless write=True.
Follow coaching_method when planning.

function.name: update_workout
function.description:
Replace an existing workout with an edited version (e.g. rename an exercise). Returns the list of
field changes. Refuses missing docs and id changes. Dry run unless write=True.
Mid-workout change: update the same assigned workout with the new plan (planned sets, no done
flags); when the user taps Load, the tracker keeps their logged sets and takes the rest from it.
Follow coaching_method when planning.

function.name: list_todos
function.description: The user's todos, open ones first: dated by due (earliest first), then undated. Each has a docId.

function.name: add_todo
function.description:
Add a todo. due is free text, a date or a date and time (e.g. '2026-10-12' or '2026-10-12 19:00'),
so timed todos double as a light agenda. Saves immediately (no dry run).

function.name: update_todo
function.description:
Change a todo: check it off (done=True), reopen it, edit text, due or notes. Leave a field out to keep it;
pass '' to clear due or notes. Saves immediately (no dry run).

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Delete a todo for good. Prefer done=True for finished ones; delete only what the user wants gone.
